messages:
devon: Heads-up — starting AWS/GCP/Azure listing onboarding for Redwood Inference. Need to align roles, billing SKU, trial entitlements, and legal artifact deadlines. Who's available for a quick sync? /cc @alice

alice: can do. Do we have the asset manifest from product? need logo + 1-liner + support email + offering SKU.

ben: legal asks for updated EULA and SOC2 statement. I can share the EULA redlines by EOD. Also confirm that we support 30-day trial SKU?

carol: product: yes 30-day trial. Packaging: Offer = 'Redwood Inference — Hosted API' with two SKUs: payg + reserved. I'll attach the short description and feature bullets in the playbook link: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/playbook

devon: thanks. Ben, can you paste the EULA filename? And Alice, can you create publisher console entries for GCP/Azure as well?

alice: EULA filename = redwood_eula_v3_2026.pdf. I'll add publisher roles. For GCP we need the support contact + deployment guide link. ETA tomorrow 10am PT.

ben: uploaded redwood_eula_v3_2026.pdf to shared legal bucket. Also requesting export control check — @carol can you confirm no restricted image assets?

carol: Confirmed. All assets are open. Also we need telemetry hooks for rev share tracking: set tag = rw.marketplace.offer_id. Eng infra @sam — can you add tag to event emitter?

sam: yep, will add event tag and a lightweight lambda shim for stitching offer_id into usage pings. I'll put a small PR with :memo: instructions.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace submission window opens 2026-02-18 09:00PT. Preflight checklist due 3 days prior.

devon: noted. Let's do short checklist in thread: 1) assets + logos (alice) 2) EULA & SOC2 (ben) 3) SKU mapping + trial config (carol) 4) publisher console entries (alice) 5) telemetry tag (sam) 6) legal signatures (ben).

alice: I'll start a quick doc and ping a calendly for 30m tomorrow.
